name: Super Cup Football
summary: Supercup Football is an action-oriented football game played from a top-down perspective. The player participates in a league with a total of ten teams. In terms of controls, the game offers the usual mix of shooting, running, and tackling. A unique feature is a special move to perform a curling cross. When the opponent enters the penalty area, the player automatically takes control of the goalkeeper. During the game, the color of the field's grass can be changed in real-time.
